text.p: Following are the main stories in Thursday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- The Malaysian Cabinet wants Singapore's Senior Minister Lee Kuan Yew to retract a statement criticising Malaysia's southern Johor state as a place of "shootings, muggings and and car-jackings."

-- Petronas, the national oil company is to develop passenger car engines with the help of its Formula One racing partner Sauber of Switzerland. The first two-litre prototype is expected to be released in June 1998.
-- Malaysia ticked off Singapore for making disparaging remarks about Malaysia's southern Johor state.
-- A yacht belonging to the Sultan of Johor was gutted in a fire after it was struck by lightning on Wednesday.
